title: Set the default application for a file type
summary: Use xdg-mime to choose which application opens specific file types (MIME types). For example, set GIMP as the default for JPEG images.

aliases.text: change default app for file type

prerequisites: Know the MIME type of the file (e.g., image/jpeg) and the .desktop file of the app

steps.explain: Set the default application for a specific MIME type. Replace <APP_DESKTOP> with the .desktop file name (e.g., gimp.desktop) and <MIME_TYPE> with the type (e.g., image/jpeg).

placeholders.name: APP_DESKTOP
placeholders.description: The .desktop file name of the application.

placeholders.name: MIME_TYPE
placeholders.description: The MIME type of the files you want to open.

alternatives.explain: Set a specific application as the default for one or more MIME types.

placeholders.name: APP_DESKTOP
placeholders.description: The .desktop file name of the application, e.g., imv.desktop

placeholders.name: MIME_TYPE
placeholders.description: The MIME type to associate, e.g., image/png

verify.expect: The command outputs the .desktop file name you just set.

rollback.explain: Set the default application back to the previous one.

placeholders.name: OLD_APP_DESKTOP
placeholders.description: The .desktop file name of the previous default application.
